subject: geography
title: Continents and major physical features
objective: Place the continents and their great physical features.

lesson.opening: Seven continents hold the world’s great mountain ranges, deserts, and plains.

sections.heading: The continents
sections.body: Asia, Africa, North America, South America, Antarctica, Europe, and Australia. Asia is the largest; Australia the smallest inhabited continent.

sections.heading: Great ranges and deserts
sections.body: The Himalayas, Andes, and Rockies are young, high ranges. The Sahara and the Australian outback are vast dry regions.

sections.heading: Rivers and plains
sections.body: The Amazon, Nile, and Yangtze drain huge basins and support dense settlement.

activities.prompt: Name one great physical feature and the continent it is on.
activities.context: Continents hold distinctive mountain ranges, deserts, and river basins.
